headline: Utility posts strong quarter, lifts full-year EPS guidance
summary_short: Atmos Energy's fiscal Q2 (ended March 31, 2026) diluted EPS rose to $3.47 from $3.03 a year earlier as operating income grew 21.6% to $764.8M on roughly flat revenue of $1.96B. Full-year diluted EPS guidance was raised to $8.40-$8.50 from $8.15-$8.35.
summary_long: Diluted EPS of $3.47 rose 14.5% y/y and 42.2% q/q on seasonal winter demand; net income grew 19.8% y/y to $581.9M and operating income rose 21.6% y/y to $764.8M, while revenue was roughly flat y/y at $1.96B. The release does not explain the increase beyond noting $135.3M of annualized regulatory outcomes implemented in the quarter. Atmos raised full-year fiscal 2026 diluted EPS guidance to $8.40-$8.50 (from $8.15-$8.35) and guided full-year capex to approximately $4.2B. The board declared a $1.00 quarterly dividend, an indicated annual rate of $4.00 (+14.9% vs fiscal 2025). Cash fell to $125.7M from $367.0M q/q; equity capitalization stood at 60.9%.
